title: Juicy Mediterranean Veal Stir-fry
description: A herbal and juicy mediterranean dish featuring lean veal meat, perfect for a sick-day meal that's also low-fat-friendly.

ingredients.name: Sea salt and black pepper, to taste

instructions: Season the veal cutlets with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper on both sides.
Heat a bit of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the seasoned veal to the pan, cooking each side for about 2-3 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the sliced red bell pepper and diced onion. Sauté for another minute or until slightly softened.
Pour in the lemon juice over the vegetables. Stir-fry for about a minute until it reduces slightly.
Add cherry tomatoes to the pan and stir for an additional 2 minutes. Make sure they are evenly distributed across the skillet.

Place the seasoned veal back into the skillet, arranging them around the veggies. Pour in olive oil, then add a pinch of sea salt and freshly ground black pepper. Cook on medium heat for about 6-8 minutes or until the meat is cooked through, adding more seasoning as needed to keep it juicy.
Garnish with fresh dill before serving hot.
Serve this dish alongside some crusty bread for added flavor.
